artifact_name: PAPER_system_description (draft v1) — bottom-up systems paper on AAE @5f6e4d4

findings.element: §1 premise: 'the discipline is code, not prompts' / 'it lives in code'

accusation.text: The paper's load-bearing premise is that the guarantees are enforced in deterministic Python. Executed against the repo, the two guarantees the paper calls decisive (vendor independence, human-only VALIDATED) are enforced by string comparison, and a third (non-local >=2 sections) is never invoked in the documented entry point. The premise holds for the defense-gate and coverage-gate but not for the closure guarantees.
accusation.evidence: Direct execution of scripts/run_core.py and aae/gates.py:evaluate_completion; see F-VENDOR, F-HUMAN, F-SECTIONS.

findings.action: Restate the premise with the scope the code supports: two of the three gates are code; the closure conditions are conventions on an operator-supplied string.
findings.declared_limit: This audit is single-nature (independence level 1) and cannot close its own verdict.

findings.element: §4 table, row 'external identity present, different vendor, not human -> CROSS_MODEL_REVIEWED'

accusation.text: evaluate_completion computes has_external = bool(external_identity) and external_identity != internal_identity. There is no vendor check. Running the full documented pipeline with internal_identity='anthropic:claude-opus-4' and external_identity='anthropic:claude-sonnet-4' returns CROSS_MODEL_REVIEWED and prints the literal justification 'Reviewed by a different-vendor model'. The arbitrary string 'x' also returns CROSS_MODEL_REVIEWED. The vendor-aware code exists (aae/independence_ledger.py::_vendor, aae/adapters.py::independence_level_between) but is never consulted by evaluate_completion; run_core.py sets independence_level=2 correctly AFTER the completion state has already been assigned. The deterministic core therefore emits a false factual claim about its own independence — the exact failure mode the engine exists to prevent.
accusation.evidence: Executed: python3 scripts/run_core.py with a same-vendor payload -> 'completion: CROSS_MODEL_REVIEWED — Reviewed by a different-vendor model anthropic:claude-sonnet-4 (!= anthropic:claude-opus-4)'; independence_level in the emitted ledger = 2.

findings.action: Wire _vendor()/independence_level_between into evaluate_completion; emit CROSS_MODEL_REVIEWED only at level 3, and INTRA_NATURE_REVIEWED (or EXTERNAL_REVIEW_PENDING) at level 2. Then correct the §4 table row.

findings.element: §4 'Only a human external eye returns VALIDATED'

accusation.text: The single non-negotiable rule of the whole system is implemented as external_identity.lower().startswith('human'). Executed end-to-end, external_identity='humanoid-model-v2' returns VALIDATED with the message 'Human external review by humanoid-model-v2 recorded' and sets independence to HUMAN_DOMAIN_EXPERT. Since the payload (including external_identity) is authored by the orchestrating model per SKILL.md step 5, the claim in §4 that 'the process cannot self-report validated' is not enforced by the code: any string beginning with 'human' closes the loop.
accusation.evidence: Executed: run_core.py with external_identity='humanoid-model-v2' -> 'completion: VALIDATED'. Same prefix flaw duplicated at aae/independence_ledger.py::_is_human.

findings.action: Require a structured human attestation (e.g. reserved 'human:' scheme plus a non-empty reviewer field and a timestamp) rather than a prefix; document that the operator, not the model, must supply it.

findings.element: §4 'Non-closure is not a posture here; it is a hook that fails the run'

accusation.text: The Stop hook never fails a run. scripts/governor_check.py states in its own docstring 'Exit code is always 0 (a Stop hook should inform, not crash the session)' and main() returns 0 unconditionally. Moreover governor_check.py never reads the completion state: run on the ledger that had just been stamped VALIDATED via a fake human identity, it printed 'RELIABLE_WITH_RESERVATIONS' and the rule text 'internal grounds can never reach VALIDATED' while exiting 0. The hook informs; it does not enforce.
accusation.evidence: Executed: python3 scripts/governor_check.py on the VALIDATED ledger -> verdict RELIABLE_WITH_RESERVATIONS, exit=0. Source: scripts/governor_check.py lines 13-15 and main().

findings.action: Either make the hook read completion_state and exit non-zero on an unsupported VALIDATED, or rewrite §4 as 'a hook that reports, outside the model's turn' and drop 'fails the run'.

findings.element: §3 'A non-local class with fewer than two cited sections is rejected by the schema as ill-formed'

accusation.text: Finding.validate() does contain the >=2 sections rule, but validate() is only reached via Ledger.integrity_report(), which is called solely from aae/orchestrator.py:194. The documented entry point scripts/run_core.py calls adjudicate_all, enforce_defense_gate, enforce_coverage_gate, enforce_grounding and evaluate_completion, and never integrity_report(). Constructing a NON_LOCAL_MECHANICAL finding with sections=['s1'] succeeds and survives the pipeline. The rule is written but inert on the path the paper and the SKILL tell a reader to run.
accusation.evidence: grep of all non-test callers of integrity_report()/validate(); direct construction test; sed of run_core.py:45-70.

findings.action: Call ledger.integrity_report() inside run_core.run() and surface the problems as flags; or downgrade the §3 wording to 'flagged by the integrity report'.

findings.element: §3 'A PATTERN-only accusation may flag but never condemn; the schema enforces it'

accusation.text: Attribution imprecise: the schema does not reject a pattern-based condemnation at construction time (a Finding with base=PATTERN and verdict=ARTIFACT_DEFECTIVE can be built and the defense-gate does not touch it).

defense.fact: The substantive claim holds in the pipeline: Finding.adjudicate() Rule 1 forces NEEDS_READING for any PATTERN base, and run_core.py:52 calls adjudicate_all() before any gate. A pattern-only accusation genuinely cannot condemn on the documented path. Only the phrase 'the schema enforces it' is misplaced — it is the verdict state machine.

findings.action: Reword to 'the verdict state machine enforces it (adjudicate, Rule 1)'.

findings.element: §1 'every claim below maps to a file you can read or a test you can run, so it is falsifiable line by line'

accusation.text: The universal quantifier is false for two of the paper's own load-bearing claims. (a) The blind re-adjudication of the 14 pairs (§6) has no artifact in the repo: benchmarks/real_errors and benchmarks/inter_nature contain only the coordinator's landing/decoy datasets, and §8 states the blind audits live in private sealed registers. (b) §8's assertion that each benchmark guard is 'verified non-vacuous by perturbing one datum' corresponds to no test: no file under tests/ or benchmarks/ contains a perturbation check. Anonymization does not require absence — the blind pass could ship as a second anonymized column exactly like the first.
accusation.evidence: ls of both benchmark dirs; grep -rl for perturb/vacuous across tests/ and benchmarks/ returns nothing.

findings.action: Either ship the blind pass as an anonymized column plus a guard test for non-vacuity, or soften §1 to 'every quantitative claim in §6 recomputes; the blind pass is attested, not reproducible'.

findings.element: §6 two-frontier table, column 'recovered by a different nature: yes (3/3, incl. one the primary nature missed)'

accusation.text: The primary nature missed 3/3 external-data targets, not one. The 3/3 figure belongs to nature_C alone; nature_B scores 2/3. The binary column collapses a monotone gradient (A 0/3 <= B 2/3 <= C 3/3, monotonicity asserted True by the benchmark) that is a stronger and more interesting result than the yes/no dichotomy the table presents.
accusation.evidence: benchmarks/inter_nature/reproduce.py --strict output: nature_A 0/3, nature_B 2/3, nature_C 3/3, 'monotone non-decreasing A<=B<=C: True'.

findings.action: Replace the binary column with the 0/3, 2/3, 3/3 vector and state the monotonicity; it strengthens the independence-frontier claim rather than weakening it.

accusation.text: 155 reads as a global figure but is the per-paper vanilla count for target T4 only; the aggregate is 620 findings across 7 papers (mean 88.6).

defense.fact: The figure is traceable to the versioned dataset and the same phrasing appears in benchmarks/baselines/README.md; T4 is a domain-re-derivation target, so it is the pertinent case for the sentence's argument. Only the referent is ambiguous to a reader.

findings.action: Write 'a vanilla firehose of up to 155 findings on that very target'.

accusation.text: The workflow triggers on push only for branches [main], plus pull_request and workflow_dispatch — not on every push.

defense.fact: pull_request is unrestricted, so any branch that opens a PR is covered; the matrix ['3.10','3.11','3.12','3.13'] and all four --strict benchmarks plus the 137-test suite are genuinely in the workflow. The claim's substance (every merged state is checked on four interpreters) holds.

findings.action: Say 'on main and on every pull request'.

findings.element: §2/§5 quantitative self-description: commit, module count, LOC, test count, benchmark reproduction

accusation.text: Checked whether the paper's self-reported figures overstate the artifact.

defense.fact: All figures verified by execution and none is inflated: 30 .py modules under aae/ and 4244 total lines (paper: '~4,200 across 30 small modules'); 'Ran 137 tests ... OK' (paper: 137 passing); all four reproduce.py --strict exit 0 from a clean clone with no install; §6's numbers all recompute (P recall 1/4=25%, decoy FP 0/7 on all three natures, synthetic 14/16=88%, over-flagging 5.00x overall with range 2.5x-8.4x, disciplined mean 17.7 vs vanilla 88.6, landing 4/7 identical per-paper, statcheck 0/7); the DefectClass and Verdict enums quoted in §3-§4 match aae/schema.py; the agent front-matter (sonnet for hostile roles, opus for governor, disallowedTools Write/Edit, effort and maxTurns) matches agents/*.md; the defense-gate downgrades an undefended condemnation to NEEDS_EXPERT and the coverage-gate flags 5 uncovered dimensions, both as described. I also perturbed the load-bearing columns myself: flipping a 'landed' value and injecting a decoy false positive each make reproduce.py --strict exit 2, so the guards are non-vacuous where it counts.

findings.declared_limit: Verified single-nature and single-run; recall variance across runs (the paper's own declared fragility) is not testable from a clone.
